DAV_USERNAME.description: Username Memora signs in with. Enter the same one in Memora under **Settings → Sync**.

DAV_PASSWORD.description: Password Memora signs in with. Use a long random one.

ALLOWED_ORIGIN.description: Site allowed to call this server, for example `https://app.memora.im`. Leave `*` to allow any.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket that stores your synced data.
